headline: Operation Lawful Strike — Complete
message:
You now understand the single thing that separates a security professional from a criminal: authorisation. Same skills. Same tools. Same techniques. One signed piece of paper makes all the difference.

This principle — PSP, Permission, Scope, Privacy — is not just the foundation of ethical hacking. It is the foundation of your entire career in security. Every decision you make from here starts with the question: am I authorised to do this?
